layers.deciding_comparison: The selections are two alternative finalists; a single winner remains undecided. On the specified clean WSL2 Linux x86_64 host, compare ast-grep 0.45.3 and Semgrep CE 1.179.0, with NodeSeek and GritQL as challengers, against a fixed ripgrep-plus-symbol-navigation baseline. Use a labeled corpus of structural queries covering multiline code, comments/strings, repeated captures, nested calls and safe rewrites. Measure precision, recall, incorrect rewrites and total agent tokens per correctly answered query, using identical agent/client settings and counting retries and tool output. Record clean-install success and cold/warm latency separately. If the text/symbol baseline covers the required tasks with equivalent correctness and lower token cost, the no-additional-component option should win. Repeat the leading arms on macOS arm64 for secondary-platform validation.
evidence_gaps: The packet supplies no comparison where every named arm ran. The inspected upstream evidence does not establish comparative precision, recall or agent-token superiority on the target host.

Greph's published WordPress CI benchmark reports 2859.27 ms versus ast-grep's 4090.82 ms for new $CLASS(), but 5537.70 ms versus 4133.41 ms for array($$$ITEMS). These are workload-specific runtime results, not a general quality ranking. [Benchmark tables](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inline0/greph/a2fe0e83c343877507a9c8fcd16fee365e57e9b9/README.md).

NodeSeek reports 0.031 seconds and 983 structural matches on an Apple M4 corpus, versus grep's 0.011 seconds and 1070 text hits. The README explains that the tools answer different questions; those counts are not labeled precision/recall evidence. [Benchmark methodology](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/connorg45/nodeseek/56ad43154113b6cf5db7c4e8763c8ffb7386e334/README.md).

No clean-host installation or runtime test was performed. Ast-grep's Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 release artifacts were verified in the release API. Semgrep documents Linux/WSL/macOS installation, but its macOS arm64 package support was not independently verified within this budget. The documented parser-based workloads imply CPU use; the RTX 4090 is not needed for the described functionality.

All eight repositories are unarchived and have a default-branch commit within 2026-07-04 through 2026-10-02, so none meets the frozen stale exclusion. Recent commits include documentation-only and bot changes, which provide less maintenance evidence than substantive development. Issue response times and closure activity were not sampled; open issue/PR counts are backlog snapshots.

The required ctx_fetch_and_index tool was denied by the environment with 'requires approval, but approval policy is never'. Eight pinned upstream READMEs were instead fetched through read-only HTTP, indexed with ctx_index and read with ctx_search. This deviates from the requested fetch route.

Research used 30 GitHub API calls and eight successful page fetches. One denied ctx fetch request retrieved no page. A web-search request containing three queries failed with an upstream timeout and supplied no evidence.
